summary: Bain Capital Private Credit (BCPC), a Delaware BDC, filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing entry into an indenture and first supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company for $350,000,000 of 7.600% unsecured notes due October 8, 2031. Notes pay semiannually each April 8 and October 8, starting April 8, 2027, and are redeemable at the company's option. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes and may repay revolver debt. A change-of-control plus below-investment-grade rating triggers a 100% repurchase offer. This is a routine private-placement debt offering, not a special situation.
